title: Replace ideal bias current sources with self-biasing reference circuit
context: The classifier top-level has 2 remaining ideal elements: Ibias_master_n (1uA) and Ibias_master_p (1uA) at lines 1227-1231 of top_level_classifier_circuit.spice. These ideal current sources must be replaced with a real transistor-based bias reference that starts autonomously from VDD=1.8V. This is the classifier-specific portion of MAJOR-008 (No Startup / Independence Circuits). The frontend LDO and frontend .ic elimination are deferred to MAJOR-007 integration.

success_criteria.target: 0 ideal current sources (I elements) in top_level_classifier_circuit.spice
ngspice .op converges without any .ic statements (zero initial conditions)
success_criteria.measurement_method: Run ngspice .op on top_level_classifier_circuit.spice, verify exit code 0 and 'done' in output
success_criteria.current_value: PASS (already converges with ideal sources, need to verify with real reference)

success_criteria.target: Same WTA winner as baseline (out2 = class 2 winner), margin >= 10mV over runner-up
success_criteria.measurement_method: Extract v(out0)-v(out4) from .op, verify argmax unchanged and margin preserved

success_criteria.target: Master bias current within 20% of 1uA target (0.8-1.2 uA)
success_criteria.measurement_method: Measure I(Xbias_master_n) or V(nbias_master_n) in .op, compare to baseline

success_criteria.target: Predicted analog accuracy regression < 0.5% from baseline (94.71%)
success_criteria.measurement_method: If bias current shifts, evaluate impact on mirror calibration accuracy. Full re-characterization only if current error > 10%.

success_criteria.target: Only external inputs: VDD (1.8V) and ECG feature voltages. No external bias currents or reference voltages.
success_criteria.measurement_method: Audit netlist for I-sources, V-sources (except VDD), or .ic statements

constraints: Must use SKY130 130nm CMOS devices only (sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8, sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8)
No digital elements — fully analog bias reference
Must not change mirror gate voltages (nbias_master_n, pbias_master_p) by more than 10% from current values
Passive resistor R element is acceptable (represents physical poly resistor)
Must integrate into generate_top_level_classifier() in retrain_circuit_features.py
dependencies: MAJOR-003 (COMPLETE — all other ideal elements already replaced)
risk_factors: Bias current mismatch: if reference produces != 1uA, all 72 mirror currents shift proportionally. Impact is systematic (all channels shift same direction), so relative accuracy may be preserved.
Convergence: self-biasing loops can have multiple equilibria. The R-based approach avoids this (no loop, natural startup).
Resistor value: 1.3MOhm poly resistor is large but physically realizable in SKY130 high-res poly (650 squares at 2kOhm/sq).
